source_rule: Fixed v8 final, identical to the v9 starting checkpoint; never pick a v9 intermediate or best checkpoint. Reuse the exact v9 selection of 25 starts from this actor's 162 saved train episodes.

solve.method: numpy.linalg.lstsq float64, one solve per original linear head, minimum Euclidean displacement from that source head on the fixed float32 body features plus bias
solve.rule: Freeze actor and both original critic bodies. Deep-copy source, solve A*delta=target-A*head_source once for each head, cast the new head to the original float32 dtype, and evaluate through the unchanged production network. No epsilon/label/sign shift, retry, tolerance sweep, alternate source, architecture change or extra data. Report precision errors and all local signs even if the solve appears exact in float64.

acceptance: Use unchanged v9 local numeric/component/joint sign checks and unchanged original v5 full 90+72 episode train_gate before and after. Report all regressions. Local success shows only finite known-start expressibility; full train failure remains failure. Neither result allows development evaluation, G4, NAV-066 or deployment.
failure_policy: Any actual candidate head solve is model fitting, including this non-iterative method, and requires a new approved/hash-pinned registration. Exclusive output; preserve partial attempts/checkpoints and failures. No automatic continuation, transfer, enlargement or reuse of ended optimizer quotas.
downstream: Diagnostic-only checkpoint and full-train impact review. If local solve passes, prioritize global fitting/stability on original plus boundary/along-path data; if it fails, diagnose numeric representation. No automatic architectural change or six-candidate expansion.
